title: The Fork Inn - Master Bedroom w Huge bathroom (F1)
description:
First Floor Master Bedroom suite  in Large farmhouse. Large tub and shower in your enormous private bathroom.  Share large kitchen, living room, dining area and formal dining room. Located adjacent to beautiful barn in the historic, romantic, rural paradise of Big East Fork Valley

The space
Located in the center of a 2500 acre conservation land easement, surrounded by meadows, creeks, forest , and diverse abundant wildlife. Spacious front and back porches complete with rocking chairs. Bring your camera!

Guest access
Guests may access kitchen, Living room, dining area, formal dining room, large front and back porches, hiking trails, natural creeks. Big East Fork Retreat with its 6-acre natural lake is one mile away.

Other things to note
The Leipers Fork Puckett’s is the place to be on Thursday nights to listen (and perhaps perform in) the BEST open mic night in the Country!

We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.

We look forward to your stay
